svg.title: PEC TE10 propagation and TE101 closed cavity
svg.desc: a=20 mm, b=10 mm, L=60 mm, eps_r=1, mu_r=1
svg.text: a=20 mm, b=10 mm, L=60 mm, eps_r=1, mu_r=1
TE10 port f=10 GHz; closed-cavity f101=7.90022 GHz
beta / kc solid; alpha / kc dashed (dimensionless)
Closed cavity: E_y / E0 = sin(pi x/a) sin(pi z/L), y-independent
x: 0 to 20 mm (left to right); z: 0 to 60 mm (bottom to top)
Darker blue = larger positive E_y/E0, range 0 to 1; not power density.
PEC cavity has no dissipative linewidth or coupling port in this model.
